description: Tension lifecycle (#181). Default: list persisted tension records (unresolved first). scan:true runs an LLM contradiction scan, persists NEW detections as records, and skips already-recorded pairs. Lifecycle actions: action:"confirm" (real conflict), action:"dismiss" (false positive — pair suppressed from future scans), action:"resolve" + winner:<engram_id> (loser engram retired). Scan requires OPENAI_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY env var, or explicit llm_base_url + llm_api_key args.

action.description: Lifecycle action on a persisted tension record (requires id). confirm: mark real. dismiss: false positive, suppress the pair. resolve: pick winner (requires winner), the losing engram is retired.

batch_size.description: Pairs judged per LLM call in scan mode (default: 5). Set to 1 for sequential single-pair judging.

id.description: Tension record id (T-YYYY-MMDD-NNN) for action mode

llm_api_key.description: API key for the LLM (scan mode)

llm_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for scan mode (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1)

llm_model.description: Model name for scan mode (default: gpt-4o-mini)

max_pairs.description: Maximum candidate pairs to evaluate in scan mode (default: 50)

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence threshold for scan mode (0–1, default: 0.7)

persist.description: Persist scan detections as tension records (default true). Set false for a dry-run scan that also ignores the recorded-pair suppress list.

scan.description: Run an active contradiction scan using an LLM judge. New detections are persisted as tension records; recorded pairs (any status) are skipped. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY env var, or explicit llm_base_url + llm_api_key args.

status.description: List-mode status filter. Default: unresolved records (detected + confirmed).

temporal_discount.description: Multiply judge confidence by a days-apart ladder (same day x1.0 ... 15+ days x0.3) in scan mode (#240). Overrides the config default (tensions.temporal_discount, off by default). The judge prompt already carries recorded dates; enable this only when date-aware judging alone leaves too many temporal-evolution false positives.

winner.description: Engram id that wins the tension (action:"resolve" only). The other engram is retired.

name: plur_tensions
